mainEntity.name: What are the key differences between a standard pool and a luxury pool?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard pool typically focuses on basic functionality for swimming and recreation. A luxury pool, in contrast, emphasizes bespoke design, premium materials, advanced technology, and integrated outdoor living elements. Luxury pools often feature custom shapes, high-end finishes like natural stone or mosaic tiles, infinity edges, automated control systems, elaborate water features, integrated spas, and sophisticated lighting, creating a holistic outdoor resort experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury pools offer bespoke designs, premium materials, advanced technology, and integrated outdoor living elements, unlike standard pools which prioritize basic function.
